احتكرتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَرْتُنَّ (iḥtakartunna) /iħ.ta.kar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اُحْتُكِرْتُنَّ (uḥtukirtunna) /uħ.tu.kir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
